skeleton_attack_light.notes: one-hand right-hand slash. Time-warped so the hit lands ~half way (D2 skeleton SK A1 1HS: 16 frames, hit flag frame 10). Frames 0-9 blend from idle f0, last 8 blend back. Feet IK-locked on idle f0 spots. Pelvis kept 65% square so locked feet do not cross. Right upper arm lifted up to 28 deg around f9-f18 so the blade stays >= 3 cm above the floor (was 21 cm under).

skeleton_attack_heavy.notes: both hands on the grip (hand gap 0.09-0.13 m f5-f45), sword overhead ~f9-f18, chop f19-f24, blade lowest (0.17 m) at f24, held to ~f36, recovery to idle f54. Added spine bend 14+10 deg, arm pitch 30 deg, hips dip 0.13 m (f16-f46) so the blade comes all the way down. Feet IK-locked on idle f0 spots the whole clip, so the feet end exactly at the start.

not_touched: finger bones not animated (rest values); hand/wrist rotations come only from the retarget (no wrist value patching); no re-rig; mesh unchanged
